name: How much do rental property repairs usually cost between tenants?

mainEntity.name: How much do rental property repairs usually cost between tenants?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rental property repair costs depend on unit size, tenant wear, and required materials. Landlords can handle minor repairs on an hourly handyman basis, while full turnover punch lists or multi-room repairs are typically priced as flat-rate project estimates. Drywall patches, baseboard adjustments, and spot painting are relatively inexpensive, whereas replacing broken tile, damaged vanities, or subflooring increases total labor and material costs. Gathering a clear punch list before scheduling helps secure accurate upfront pricing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on scope; minor handyman patches run on hourly or small job rates, while full turnover punch lists are priced as project estimates based on materials and labor.
